> Virtual Compute assisted review scope. This assisted primary correction review applies to a fully paid most recent primary line whose completed export and contracted terms are available synchronously; no missing external evidence can be manufactured. The selected holding has no tier change or commitment-boundary crossing within the source interval and no other primary holding in this billing entity during the target period. Record one approved incorrect review with pretax net amount equal to the revised net target; tax follows the original approved tax basis. Existing review of this exact request and source is read-only. This assisted export scope requires integral instance-hour source quantities, including any reversal quantities. Within the assisted primary correction package, the same-entity active support combination determines the successive pricing adjustment and settlement concession described here in addition to request-channel eligibility; approval authority remains unchanged. A promotional primary-price entitlement remains suppressed wherever commitment pricing covers the same quantity; the two explicitly described same-entity support reductions are permitted successive adjustments, and no other cross-category benefit is stacked. This assisted primary review does not handle partially covered source quantities: for a commitment with a term other than none, the recorded committed quantity remaining after earlier posted source allocations in the same holding and service period must cover the entire net quantity of the selected source, and the recorded commitment boundaries must contain its entire source interval. For the primary review action, evidence event reference identifies the unique completed review-subtype service-record packet whose original source reference is the original primary charge and whose related evidence reference is its exact provider export; the raw export itself does not occupy this packet role.

Judgement: equivalent obligation, applicability and object/quantity semantics.

### Governing base rules: full sentence inventory and retired surface

#### compute_agg_usage → base_agg_usage_e06e094d.json

1. Use msr_portfolio_usage to select the portfolio discount.
2. Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same billing_entity and source period, even if some have since closed.
3. No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.
4. The threshold comparison is inclusive.
5. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

Prose evidence (whole bearing document, including its unchanged non-retired clauses and system-evidence bindings):

> ## Retired clause 1
> 
> This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.” Its basis has been superseded.
> 
> ## Retired clause 2
> 
> This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “Use the category pre-discount primary usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.” Its basis has been superseded.
> 
> ## Formal basis
> 
> Virtual Compute — No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts. The threshold comparison is inclusive. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.
> 
> ## Basis Q&A
> 
> **What is the judgement for agg usage?**
> 
> Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies;
> 
> ## Recorded accounting basis
> 
> The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier standard unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

#### compute_evt_category_meters → base_evt_category_meters_cb3b52e4.json

1. The primary instance package has vcpu_count virtual cores, memory_gib memory and boot_disk_gb included boot storage.
2. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price.
3. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated_factor before the normal discount priority.
4. For spot configuration use spot_discount instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing.
5. Meter code boot_storage bills only provisioned GB-month above boot_disk_gb at boot_disk_rate.
6. windows_license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows_license_rate and linux_license at linux_license_rate, independently of compute discounts.
7. snapshot bills GB-month at snapshot_rate; image_export bills processed GB at image_export_rate.
8. internet_egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included_egress_gb at egress_rate.
9. Resource_count, measured duration and the selected tier vcpu_count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals.
10. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge.
11. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export.
12. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax.
13. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.
14. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.
15. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices.
16. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.
17. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.
18. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.
19. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

```yaml
      compute_events.compute_event_id: compute_event_id
  temporal_basis:
    clock: frozen_time
    anchor_event: the official incident closes
    anchor_source: compute_events.incident_closed_at
    relation: not_after
    duration_source: variants.credit_claim_days
    unit: calendar_days
    counting_rule: Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at,
      preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting
      business days or elapsed-hour periods.
    boundary: inclusive
- id: approved_service_credit
  applies_to:
  - compute_credit
  kind: authorization
  condition: For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision
    eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does
    not constrain filing or reviewing the request.
  evidence_fields:

  - compute_events.source_event_id

  - compute_events.credited_amount
  evidence_contract:
    authority: system_record
    timing: pre_action
    correlation_keys:
    - - compute_events.source_event_id
    action_bindings:
      compute_events.source_event_id: source_event_id
```
#### compute_evt_tax → base_evt_tax_571d0be1.json

1. The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.
2. Use the source contract tax_treatment reviewed at the service date and tax_rates.
3. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using amount_precision and rounding_mode.
4. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.
5. Tax credits have negative tax_amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax_amount.
6. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are POLICY_NOT_COVERED, not assumed exempt.
7. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.
8. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

Prose evidence (whole bearing document, including its unchanged non-retired clauses and system-evidence bindings):

> ## Formal basis
> 
> Virtual Compute — The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rate schedule. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.
> 
> ## Evidence — tax evidence
> 
> For charge, credit, debit adjustment, The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

### Workflow source → ordered prose

The complete source workflow expressly declares the route; this is not an inferred prerequisite checklist.

```yaml
id: compute_assisted_cash_resolution
scenario: An existing customer-filed maximum-refund request concerns the latest paid
  primary source line. A corrected source target creates a surplus whose permitted
  payout is assessed by the accountant and disposed of by the customer personally;
  one payout completes the request, with any remaining surplus retained.
prerequisite: []
steps:
- tool: review_compute_line_e30849b6
  owner: agent
  writes: compute_events
  subject: compute_review
  base_policy_refs:
  - compute_evt_review
  - compute_evt_service_credit
  role: review_compute_line
  computed_by:
  - compute_ext_assisted_review
  requires_external_wait: false
  zero_wait_proof: Every physical export and original source charge already exists;
    the desk completes this arithmetic review synchronously.
- tool: credit_compute_line_adb33dcc
  owner: agent
  writes: compute_events
  subject: compute_credit
  base_policy_refs:
  - compute_evt_tax
  - compute_evt_correction
  - compute_evt_service_credit
  role: credit_compute_line
  computed_by:
  - compute_ext_assisted_credit
  requires_external_wait: false
  zero_wait_proof: The preceding review provides the approved incorrect target; this
    call immediately posts the correction.
- tool: authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0
  owner: agent
  writes: compute_events
  subject: compute_review
  base_policy_refs:
  - compute_evt_review
  - compute_evt_service_credit
  role: Accountant assesses the original customer request and payment after the exact
    source correction, recording the permitted financial ceiling.
  computed_by:
  - compute_ext_refund_assessment
  requires_external_wait: false
  zero_wait_proof: The original filed request and posted payment preexist the consultation;
    the preceding credit is now posted. The accountant performs the request/payment
    reconciliation and records its numerical assessment synchronously.
- tool: refund_compute_payment_f0565a85
  owner: user
  writes: compute_events
  subject: compute_refund
  base_policy_refs:
  - compute_evt_refund
  role: Customer executes the exact permitted refund using their original filed request
    and the accountant assessment.
  computed_by:
  - compute_ext_immediate_refund
  requires_external_wait: false
  zero_wait_proof: Original customer consent is recorded at opening; the preceding
    accountant tool has completed the eligibility assessment and returns its reference.
    The customer immediately executes the handed-over disposition tool; no later action
    depends on its receipt.
dataflow:
- from_step: 0
  to_step: 1
  kind: object_binding
  source_table: compute_events
  source_field: compute_event_id
  consumer_bindings:
  - action_arg: related_event_id
    role: direct
- from_step: 1
  to_step: 2
  kind: object_binding
  source_table: compute_events
  source_field: compute_event_id
  consumer_bindings:
  - action_arg: correction_event_id
    role: direct
- from_step: 2
  to_step: 3
  kind: object_binding
  source_table: compute_events
  source_field: compute_event_id
  consumer_bindings:
  - action_arg: related_event_id
    role: direct
order_rationale: The primary review precedes correction because its approved net target
  determines the credit. The credit precedes the refund assessment because the exact
  posted correction reference and its resulting surplus are inputs to that assessment.
  The assessment precedes customer disposition because its approved numerical ceiling
  and returned reference constrain the actual payout. Customer signature consent is
  already present on the original request; no asynchronous signature approval, payment
  clearing or other external event is manufactured.
requires_external_wait: false
zero_wait_proof: All original customer consent, export and posted payment records
  preexist the consultation. Review, credit and refund assessment are synchronous
  accountant actions. The customer then executes the final disposition using the already
  returned assessment reference; no subsequent call consumes the user-generated receipt.
```

### Atomic tool contracts

`review_compute_line_e30849b6` → `assisted_review_entry_e5c49a36.json`. Complete source interface:

> Record an accountant arithmetic review for one primary invoice line against its provider export. The review records the corrected pretax amount and an incorrect decision; a successful receipt identifies the official completed review without moving money.
> 
> Args:
>     compute_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the compute contract, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.
>     customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer profile, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.
>     compute_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the source-correlated evidence packet returned by find_compute_events: the compute service record with source_subtype review, source_event_id equal to the original primary charge, and related_event_id equal to that charge's provider export reference.
>     source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice line or payment being handled, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.
>     related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the related export or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.
>     net_amount: Fixed-format class — The corrected pretax amount in units of USD to two decimals, supplied as a decimal number already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion; stored to two decimals, with no empty value.
> 
> Returns:
>     A string receipt saying "Recorded compute_review" followed by compute_event_id, the new internal event reference as a string. That receipt confirms successful approved registration and the business effect described above.

### base_evt_service_credit_1b35d21b.json — Virtual Compute: the outage service-credit basis

Unique normative source: `compute_evt_service_credit` .

> ## Formal basis
> 
> Virtual Compute — For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its request notice time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded request notice time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closing time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. ### cash_resolution_procedure_ebc5daee.json — Virtual Compute: assisted cash resolution procedure

Unique normative source: `compute_assisted_cash_resolution` .

> ## Situation
> 
> Virtual Compute — An existing customer-filed maximum-refund request concerns the latest paid primary source line. A corrected source target creates a surplus whose permitted payout is assessed by the accountant and disposed of by the customer personally; one payout completes the request, with any remaining surplus retained.
> 
> ## Ordered action 1
> 
> 1. The agent records the primary arithmetic review using review_compute_line_e30849b6. Every physical export and original source charge already exists; the desk completes this arithmetic review synchronously.
> 
> ## Ordered action 2
> 
> 2. The agent posts the primary correction credit using credit_compute_line_adb33dcc. The preceding review provides the approved incorrect target; this call immediately posts the correction.
> 
> ## Ordered action 3
> 
> 3. The agent records the numerical refund assessment using authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0. The original filed request and posted payment preexist the consultation; the preceding credit is now posted. The accountant performs the request/payment reconciliation and records its numerical assessment synchronously.
> 
> ## Ordered action 4
> 
> 4. The customer themselves executes the permitted refund using refund_compute_payment_f0565a85. Original customer consent is recorded at opening; the preceding accountant tool has completed the eligibility assessment and returns its reference. The customer immediately executes the handed-over disposition tool; no later action depends on its receipt.
> 
> ## Reference handovers
> 
> The review reference becomes the correction’s related evidence. The correction reference becomes the assessment’s posted-correction reference. The approved assessment reference becomes the customer refund’s related evidence.
> 
> ## Ordering basis
> 
> The primary review precedes correction because its approved net target determines the credit. The credit precedes the refund assessment because the exact posted correction reference and its resulting surplus are inputs to that assessment. The assessment precedes customer disposition because its approved numerical ceiling and returned reference constrain the actual payout. Customer signature consent is already present on the original request; no asynchronous signature approval, payment clearing or other external event is manufactured.
> 
> ## Synchronous execution
> 
> All original customer consent, export and posted payment records preexist the consultation. Review, credit and refund assessment are synchronous accountant actions. The customer then executes the final disposition using the already returned assessment reference; no subsequent call consumes the user-generated receipt.
> 
> ## Hypothetical case
> 
> Hypothetically, correction before review lacks the approved target; assessment before correction lacks the posted credit reference and its resulting surplus; customer payout before assessment lacks the approved ceiling and returned assessment reference.
